data.name: ecoLocked
data.description: ecoLocked is a Berlin-based climate-tech startup founded in 2021 that produces biochar-based concrete admixtures, turning the built environment into a durable CO2 sink. Its flagship product eLM Zero can reduce concrete's net CO2 footprint by up to 100%, and the company sells third-party-verified carbon removal certificates alongside its materials.
